summary: The test suite covers core functionality well—status detection, report generation, both output formats, and workflow integration—with 31 test cases across unit, structure, and integration layers. However, gaps are notable: (1) the `-OutputPath` parameter is never tested, (2) `-FailOnExpired` at the script level isn't validated in integration tests, (3) only 2 integration fixtures exist (missing all-expired, all-warning, large-dataset scenarios), (4) no tests for invalid inputs (negative RotationPolicyDays, malformed dates, special characters), (5) no boundary tests for zero/negative WarningDays. The test design is strong—well-organized with clear naming, good fixtures, and solid separation of unit/structure/integration concerns—but integration test JSON extraction is somewhat brittle (regex-based log-prefix stripping). Would catch most regressions in core logic and workflow structure but would miss edge-case and parameter-handling failures. The unit tests thoroughly exercise the module functions and error cases, but the script itself (`Invoke-RotationCheck.ps1`) is only indirectly tested through integration, leaving its direct parameter handling unvalidated at the unit level.
